IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Monday 2 November
Winds: North to northeasterly below 10 knots becoming east to southeasterly in the middle of the day then tending south to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the early afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Tuesday 3 November
Winds: South to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots tending south to southeasterly in the middle of the day then becoming variable below 10 knots in the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Wednesday 4 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots.
Seas: Below 0.5 metres.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 90% chance of showers.

Thursday 5 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots tending south to southwesterly during the day then tending northwesterly during the afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.
IDT12420.synoptic: A low pressure system is forecast to move across Victoria and cross the Bass Strait today, before moving over the Tasman Sea tomorrow. A cold front is expected to move across Tasmania from the west on Wednesday followed by a more significant cold front later Friday.

Wednesday 4 November

Seas: Around 1 metre.
Swell: Southwesterly 1.5 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: Northeasterly around 1 metre.
